metadata.question: Around the Lake Eerie and upstate New York, was there more snow on March 1, 2020 in comparison to the same region on February 22, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lake Erie and upstate New York region (need to define a geometry covering this area) - Dates: March 1, 2020 vs February 22, 2020 - Collection: MODIS Snow Cover (MOD10A1.061 or MYD10A1.061) or Sentinel-2 for snow mapping - MODIS Terra Snow Cover Daily (MOD10A1.061) has NDSI_Snow_Cover band (0-100 where higher = more snow) 2. Masking strategy: - For MODIS snow product, filter out clouds and use valid snow cover pixels - Compare total snow cover area or mean snow cover between two dates 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If there's legitimately less/no snow on one date (answer B or A) - C1: If no images found for either date - C2: If images exist but all pixels are masked/invalid - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN/invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Lake Erie and upstate New York const lakeErie = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-83.5, 41.3], [-83.5, 42.9], [-78.5, 42.9], [-78.5, 41.3], [-83.5, 41.3]] ]); // 2. Dates const date1 = '2020-02-22'; const date2 = '2020-03-01'; // 3. Load MODIS Snow Cover data const modisSnow = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1'); // Get images for both dates const img1 = modisSnow .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(lakeErie) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover') .first(); const img2 = modisSnow .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(lakeErie) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover') .first(); // Check if images exist const img1Exists = await new Promise((resolve) => { img1.getInfo((result, error) => { resolve(!error && result !== null); }); }); const img2Exists = await new Promise((resolve) => { img2.getInfo((result, error) => { resolve(!error && result !== null); }); }); if (!img1Exists || !img2Exists) { console.log("Missing data for one or both dates."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Mask clouds and water, keep only valid snow pixels const maskSnow = function(image) { const snowCover = image.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); // Values 0-100 are valid snow cover, 200=missing data, 201=no decision, 211=night, 250=cloud, 254=detector saturated, 255=fill const validMask = snowCover.gte(0).and(snowCover.lte(100)); return snowCover.updateMask(validMask); }; const snow1 = maskSnow(img1); const snow2 = maskSnow(img2); // 5. Calculate statistics const stats1 = await new Promise((resolve) => { snow1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: lakeErie, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo((result) => resolve(result)); }); const stats2 = await new Promise((resolve) => { snow2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: lakeErie, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo((result) => resolve(result)); }); const mean1 = stats1.NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean; const count1 = stats1.NDSI_Snow_Cover_count; const mean2 = stats2.NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean; const count2 = stats2.NDSI_Snow_Cover_count; console.log(`Feb 22, 2020: Mean=${mean1?.toFixed(2) || 'N/A'}, Pixels=${count1 || 0}`); console.log(`Mar 1, 2020: Mean=${mean2?.toFixed(2) || 'N/A'}, Pixels=${count2 || 0}`); // 6. Validation if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean1 == null || mean2 == null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 7. Compare snow cover console.log(`Snow cover difference: ${(mean2 - mean1).toFixed(2)} (positive = more on Mar 1)`); if (mean2 > mean1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
data.exec_msg:
Feb 22, 2020: Mean=17.45, Pixels=2123
Mar 1, 2020: Mean=42.14, Pixels=1172
Snow cover difference: 24.68 (positive = more on Mar 1)
<answer>A</answer>
